messages:
frank: Quick onboarding blocker: running the quickstart (py-sdk 0.8.2) demo chain embeddings -> rerank and seeing inconsistent vector lengths inside a single candidates array. Demo dataset = tiny-news; model=openembed-small-2026-02.

emma: can you paste the raw body (REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1) and the sampleapp tag?

frank: sampleapp: redwood/quickstart:v2026-03. Raw excerpt: 
```json
{"candidates": [{"id":"n1","vector":[0.01,...,<768 floats>]},{"id":"n2","vector":[<769 floats>]}]}
```
The first candidate has 768 floats, second 769. The SDK then throws: `ValueError: cannot reshape array of size 1537 into shape (768,)` when packing into the batching helper.

rick: weird dims 768 vs 769 — are you sure one of those isn't a parsing artifact? Any 401/403 in logs just before?

frank: yes there were a couple of 401s from the test auth token refresh right before the batch call. I noticed the container logged a retry but no error.

sdk-python: that fits a known autobatcher concat edge: we concatenated candidate floats into a single buffer during streaming to reduce allocations. If a retry occurs while appending, a partial chunk from attempt A plus attempt B could form a vector with wrong length.

emma: so server likely returned consistent vectors; client concatenation + retry caused the off-by-one. Can you reproduce with `autobatch=False`?

frank: disabling autobatch fixed the demo. Workaround: call `client.rerank.batch(..., autobatch=False)` and manually group candidates. Also `REDWOOD_RETRY_VERBOSITY=debug` shows the retry timing.

sdk-js: note: JS SDK had a similar bug earlier and added a normalize step. We need parity: py-sdk should normalize `embedding` vs `vector` fields and assert equal lengths before allocation. Also change retry semantics so retries are only attempted before body consumption.

emma: let's update the sampleapp quickstart to either pin a patched SDK or set autobatch off by default until hotfix. New users hit this during live demos.

ciara-bot: incident created: INC-2026-412 onboard-embed-dim-mismatch (priority: medium)

sdk-python: action plan: 1) add a defensive length-check in the batching helper (infer dims from first candidate). 2) add a safe-concat implementation that aborts on midstream retry. 3) release py-sdk 0.8.3 with the fix.

sdk-js: we'll mirror the change and add an e2e test that simulates auth retry during streaming.

emma: I'll push an update to the quickstart readme with the workaround and schedule the docker tag update after the SDK release.

frank: thanks, that unblocks my workshop. Will re-run after the patch and report back. :thumbsup:
